profile.name: Sanjai Harikrishnan
profile.headline: I build reliable products from API to interface.
profile.summary: Full-Stack .NET Developer with 3+ years of experience building scalable web applications with C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, React.js, and SQL Server. Skilled in RESTful APIs, event-driven microservices with RabbitMQ, Redis caching, Entity Framework Core, and query optimization. Strong in SOLID principles, Layered Architecture, and Agile/Scrum delivery. Building expertise in Microsoft Azure and distributed systems.

highlights: Own end-to-end delivery of full-stack features, from requirement analysis to production release, using ASP.NET Core Web APIs, SQL Server, and React.js.
Design and build scalable microservices and high-performance APIs using RabbitMQ, Redis caching, and layered architecture.
Developed and maintained production ASP.NET Core Web APIs with layered architecture, improving performance through Redis caching and SQL query optimization.
Designed event-driven microservices with RabbitMQ across three decoupled modules, reducing direct service dependencies and improving fault tolerance.
Implemented Redis distributed caching on high-frequency endpoints, reducing database round-trips by approximately 40% under concurrent load, validated with Postman benchmarks.
Delivered end-to-end features from ASP.NET Core APIs to React.js UI across Agile sprints, consistently meeting release timelines.
Applied SOLID principles in peer code reviews and wrote xUnit and Postman tests to improve edge-case coverage.

projects.name: Heavy-Duty Truck E-Commerce Platform
projects.subtitle: Customer storefront & admin portal
projects.overview: A B2B, B2C, and guest e-commerce experience for heavy-duty truck parts, with an internal portal for order management.
highlights: Built customer-facing journeys for product search, cart, checkout, and order placement, plus an internal Admin Portal.
Developed RESTful APIs for pricing, discounts, orders, and customer workflows using layered architecture.
Improved performance under load with Redis caching, SQL Server query tuning, and optimized API payloads.
Built reusable React components with Axios, automated order emails through Microsoft Graph API, and added on-demand PDF invoice generation.

projects.name: ATK Sales Rep
projects.subtitle: Internal order management platform
projects.overview: Backend services supporting purchase workflows, customer information, estimates, orders, and asynchronous integration with an external system.
highlights: Engineered backend services for the purchase lifecycle, including cart, estimates, orders, and customer profiles.
Integrated an external system through RabbitMQ for asynchronous order dispatch without blocking core workflows.
Optimized Entity Framework Core and SQL Server queries for high-volume data.

projects.name: Learning Experience Platform
projects.subtitle: Internal learning and reporting platform
projects.overview: An internal platform for learning administration, learner progress, course status, and reporting.
highlights: Delivered features from business requirement analysis and design through development, testing, and deployment.
Built React-based interfaces backed by .NET APIs for learning and reporting workflows.
